nodes.label: CI tests job (PS 5.1 and WPF, offline)
nodes.norm_label: ci tests job (ps 5.1 and wpf, offline)

nodes.label: CI build job (exe and setup, unsigned artifacts)
nodes.norm_label: ci build job (exe and setup, unsigned artifacts)

nodes.label: Module roles (WinGet.Exec, Parse, App.Ui, Jobs, Prefs, Tab.*, Bootstrap)
nodes.norm_label: module roles (winget.exec, parse, app.ui, jobs, prefs, tab.*, bootstrap)

nodes.label: WgtRow (INotifyPropertyChanged grid row class)
nodes.rationale: PSCustomObject NoteProperty values do not notify WPF and forced Grid.Items.Refresh(), which reset scroll position.

nodes.label: Themes via DynamicResource and re-templated controls
nodes.rationale: StaticResource resolves once and would not follow theme change; Aero2 hardcodes light colours so CheckBox, header, ContextMenu, ComboBox are re-templated; header must keep gripper thumbs.
nodes.norm_label: themes via dynamicresource and re-templated controls

nodes.label: Four install channels (source, winget-portable, installed, portable)
nodes.norm_label: four install channels (source, winget-portable, installed, portable)

nodes.label: Signing convention (never generate replacement cert)
nodes.rationale: A second key with the same subject cannot be told apart by name; without the key build.ps1 builds unsigned.

nodes.label: ADR 0001 One exe built from modules
nodes.norm_label: adr 0001 one exe built from modules

nodes.label: Marker injection build (###MODULES### and XAML markers)
nodes.rationale: ps2exe compiles one input file; markers are comment lines so main.ps1 runs from source with modules dot-sourced.
nodes.norm_label: marker injection build (###modules### and xaml markers)

nodes.label: $moduleNames single module list
nodes.rationale: Two copies would diverge and a module would silently miss the exe.

nodes.label: $AppVersion single version
nodes.rationale: Exe metadata and shown version cannot disagree; must match git tag for self-update.

nodes.label: XAML on disk wins over embedded copy
nodes.norm_label: xaml on disk wins over embedded copy

nodes.label: Dot-sourcing creates no scope; Start-App uses $script:
nodes.norm_label: dot-sourcing creates no scope; start-app uses $script:

nodes.label: requireAdministrator manifest plus main.ps1 RunAs fallback
nodes.rationale: One UAC prompt per session; no console where winget could ask.
nodes.norm_label: requireadministrator manifest plus main.ps1 runas fallback

nodes.label: Issue #12 user-scope uninstall blocked when elevated (0x8A15007D)
nodes.rationale: Deliberate winget security block; three candidate approaches, retry-unelevated-via-scheduled-task recommended, none chosen.
nodes.norm_label: issue #12 user-scope uninstall blocked when elevated (0x8a15007d)

nodes.label: ADR 0003 Only one winget process at a time
nodes.norm_label: adr 0003 only one winget process at a time

nodes.label: Test-WinGetBusy (busy or search in flight)
nodes.rationale: Searches must not raise busy state or typing stalls; asking isBusy alone left a hole.

nodes.label: $script:queueVerb publishes running queue
nodes.rationale: Assigned before Set-AppBusy true, cleared before handlers on false, otherwise Update never became Cancel.

nodes.label: Cooperative cancel via synchronized hashtable
nodes.rationale: Runspace has own scope so a script variable is invisible; killing an installer halfway leaves undefined state.

nodes.label: Invoke-WinGet (cmd redirect to temp files, WaitForExit)
nodes.rationale: Pipeline EOF waits on inheriting child processes; Start-Process loses ExitCode or waits for descendants.
nodes.norm_label: invoke-winget (cmd redirect to temp files, waitforexit)

nodes.label: Invoke-WinGetRead (direct Process.Start, UTF-8)
nodes.rationale: winget always writes UTF-8 to a pipe; decoding must not depend on a console, absent in the first scan of the noConsole exe.

nodes.label: Unbalanced-quote guard on cmd command lines
nodes.rationale: Package Ids are author-controlled and the process is elevated; does not cover %VAR% expansion.
nodes.norm_label: unbalanced-quote guard on cmd command lines

nodes.label: Clear-WinGetTempFiles startup sweep
nodes.rationale: Uses IO.File.Delete because FileSystem provider fails on 8.3 TEMP paths.

nodes.label: ADR 0005 Reads return a result, not a list
nodes.norm_label: adr 0005 reads return a result, not a list

nodes.label: Read result object (Success, Rows, ExitCode, Output)
nodes.rationale: Returning rows alone made winget failures read as 'nothing here'.
nodes.norm_label: read result object (success, rows, exitcode, output)

nodes.label: 0x8A150014 no match mapped to success in Get-WinGetSearch
nodes.norm_label: 0x8a150014 no match mapped to success in get-wingetsearch

nodes.label: ADR 0006 Parsing winget tables by column position
nodes.norm_label: adr 0006 parsing winget tables by column position

nodes.label: Get-WinGetTable positional parser
nodes.rationale: Localized fixed-width tables with spaces in names; offsets from header, re-anchored per separator row, rows told from prose by grid alignment.

nodes.label: -MaxColumns parameter
nodes.rationale: Header 'Tipo di pin' has spaces; token detection created phantom columns and dropped all rows.

nodes.label: Tables accepted from three columns up
nodes.rationale: A four-column minimum discarded winget list --source winget.
nodes.norm_label: tables accepted from three columns up

nodes.label: Set-PackagePin using winget pin add --blocking
nodes.rationale: Default Pinning type only blocks upgrade --all; upgrade --id (the app's only way) passes through it.

nodes.label: Row Pinned flag keeps pinned out of queue
nodes.norm_label: row pinned flag keeps pinned out of queue

nodes.label: Start-BackgroundJob (STA runspace, OnDone on UI thread)
nodes.rationale: Runspaces cannot touch controls, do not inherit functions or $script: scope.
nodes.norm_label: start-backgroundjob (sta runspace, ondone on ui thread)

nodes.label: DispatcherTimer 200 ms completion polling
nodes.rationale: BeginInvoke callback arrives on a non-UI thread where touching controls throws.

nodes.label: GetNewClosure scope trap
nodes.rationale: A closure gets its own module scope, $script:jobs became $null and the job polled forever; state goes through the job object.

nodes.label: WgtRow (INotifyPropertyChanged grid row class)
nodes.rationale: PSCustomObject NoteProperty values do not notify WPF, forcing Items.Refresh() which reset scroll (called 3x per package). WgtRow compiled with Add-Type raises PropertyChanged so only the changed cell repaints; type is visible in runspaces via AppDomain.

nodes.label: Theme.Light/Dark dictionaries with DynamicResource
nodes.rationale: Set-Theme swaps MergedDictionaries so window repaints without rebuild; StaticResource resolves once and would not follow theme change; both files must define same keys; no hardcoded colour in UI.xaml (White on dark accent was 2.01:1).

nodes.label: Measured contrast floors and surface step
nodes.rationale: WCAG 4.5:1 text, 3:1 graphics; controls need surface step or visible border (CtrlBorderBrush); disabled state must not use Opacity because it erased the border; BorderBrush2 kept lighter for grid lines only.
nodes.norm_label: measured contrast floors and surface step

nodes.label: Re-templated controls (CheckBox, header, ComboBox, ScrollBar)
nodes.rationale: Aero2 hardcodes light colours; re-templated DataGridColumnHeader must keep PART_LeftHeaderGripper/PART_RightHeaderGripper or column resizing silently breaks; ComboBox needs PART_Popup; ScrollBar needs PART_Track.

nodes.label: Glyphs written as [char]0xE706 (PS 5.1)
nodes.rationale: The `u{E706} escape exists only from PowerShell 6; ps2exe compiles against 5.1 where it stays literal text.

nodes.label: Settings and About as tabs; progress and log outside TabControl
nodes.rationale: v1.9.0 full-window settings overlay hid progress and log and needed ZIndex/focus/Esc plumbing; a second Window would need theme dictionaries rewired. Tabs on a DockPanel IsItemsHost since TabPanel cannot right-align one item; Updates is default tab.
nodes.norm_label: settings and about as tabs; progress and log outside tabcontrol

nodes.label: Tooltip rules (logical tree, empty string is a tooltip)
nodes.rationale: ToolTipService walks the logical tree so a TabItem tooltip leaked to every control in the page (v1.10.1); empty-string binding shows an empty box; tooltip lives on template Border and HelpText instead.
nodes.norm_label: tooltip rules (logical tree, empty string is a tooltip)

nodes.label: Grids read-only, not disabled, during operations
nodes.rationale: A disabled DataGrid stops wheel, scrollbar and keyboard so the list looked frozen.
nodes.norm_label: grids read-only, not disabled, during operations

nodes.label: Self-signed CN=WinGet Studio certificate and thumbprint selection
nodes.rationale: Only cert matching assets/WinGetStudio-codesign.cer (or WINGETSTUDIO_CERT_THUMBPRINT) signs; same-subject certs from other machines are ignored; never generate replacement, build goes unsigned. Builds not reproducible; no signing key in CI.
nodes.norm_label: self-signed cn=winget studio certificate and thumbprint selection

nodes.label: Four install channels (Get-InstallChannel)
nodes.rationale: source, winget-portable, installed, portable. winget-portable stands down because self-update broke winget's hash, .old file and uninstall entry (1.9.0 breakage); installed compares folders via 32-bit registry view.

nodes.label: SHA-256 digest verification before running download
nodes.rationale: installed channel refuses releases with no digest because setup runs as administrator; portable warns that file cannot be verified.
nodes.norm_label: sha-256 digest verification before running download

nodes.label: Rename running exe to .old and replace (portable update)
nodes.norm_label: rename running exe to .old and replace (portable update)

nodes.label: App excludes itself from Updates list (Test-IsSelfPackage)
nodes.norm_label: app excludes itself from updates list (test-isselfpackage)

nodes.label: ADR 0014 Installer alongside the portable exe
nodes.norm_label: adr 0014 installer alongside the portable exe

nodes.label: Inno Setup installer WinGetStudio.iss (machine scope, fixed AppId)
nodes.norm_label: inno setup installer wingetstudio.iss (machine scope, fixed appid)

nodes.label: WinGetStudio_Setup.exe name sorts after portable exe
nodes.rationale: GitHub API sorts assets by name; copies up to 1.10.x take the first .exe, so '-' (sorts before '.') would push the installer onto old copies; '_' sorts after. Checked after every release.
nodes.norm_label: wingetstudio_setup.exe name sorts after portable exe

nodes.label: ADR 0015 winget package: portable, then inno
nodes.norm_label: adr 0015 winget package: portable, then inno

nodes.label: winget portable-to-inno migration fields
nodes.rationale: winget refuses portable-to-inno upgrade; needs UpgradeBehavior uninstallPrevious, AppsAndFeaturesEntries declaring both inno and portable keys, ProductCode as _is1 key, and no Scope (Scope: machine failed rehearsal). Gated by Sandbox rehearsal on 2026-10-07.

nodes.label: wingetcreate update drops local manifest content
nodes.norm_label: wingetcreate update drops local manifest content

nodes.label: Offline-by-default tests with -Live opt-in
nodes.rationale: Deterministic CI independent of winget, network and signing key; -Live run remains a manual pre-release gate. Two standalone scripts Test-Ui.ps1 (mounts real app hidden, -STA) and Test-InvokeWinGet.ps1 (AST-extracted functions).

nodes.label: v1.11.0: installer alongside portable exe
nodes.rationale: Installed copy downloads installer, verifies SHA-256 (refuses without one since installer runs as admin); release asset chosen by exact name; portable listed first for <=1.10.3 copies.

nodes.label: v1.10.3: UTF-8 decoding of first scan
nodes.rationale: winget writes UTF-8 but app had no console at launch, so first scan was decoded with ANSI code page; app now reads output as UTF-8 itself.
nodes.norm_label: v1.10.3: utf-8 decoding of first scan

nodes.label: Leftover %TEMP% files swept at startup
nodes.rationale: Installers leaving background processes keep winget output files open, so they are removed on next start.

nodes.label: v1.10.2: winget failure is not an empty list
nodes.rationale: Silence from a failing winget was read as 'nothing here'; now winget's own reason is shown in place of the list.
nodes.norm_label: v1.10.2: winget failure is not an empty list

nodes.label: v1.10.2: blocking pins
nodes.rationale: Default pin only excludes from upgrade --all; upgrading by id (how the app updates) bypassed it.

nodes.label: v1.10.1: winget-portable copy must not self-replace
nodes.rationale: Self-update overwrote a winget-owned file, breaking its recorded SHA-256 and leaving winget unable to upgrade/uninstall; now defers to winget upgrade.
nodes.norm_label: v1.10.1: winget-portable copy must not self-replace

nodes.label: v1.10.1: tooltip inherited via logical tree
nodes.rationale: WPF walks logical tree for tooltips so tab content showed the tab's tooltip; moved to header. Empty string counts as tooltip.
nodes.norm_label: v1.10.1: tooltip inherited via logical tree

nodes.label: v1.10.0: Settings and About as tabs
nodes.rationale: Gear overlay covered the progress bar and log; tabs keep them visible.
nodes.norm_label: v1.10.0: settings and about as tabs

nodes.label: Cooperative cancel of update queue
nodes.rationale: Package in flight finishes; nothing killed halfway through an installer. Update locks until next Check to avoid re-running on current packages.

nodes.label: v1.10.0 fix: two winget processes at once
nodes.rationale: Search counts as winget work; all queues pass through one place taking busy state.
nodes.norm_label: v1.10.0 fix: two winget processes at once

nodes.label: Theme contrast measured by tests
nodes.rationale: Update button was 2.01:1 in dark theme; every fg/bg pair now measured so regressions cannot return quietly.

nodes.label: v1.9.0: renamed from WinGet Update Tool
nodes.rationale: Old name described only a third of the tool; v1.0.0 release removed so update check would not offer a downgrade.
nodes.norm_label: v1.9.0: renamed from winget update tool

nodes.label: On-screen prose rules (one sentence per line, no em dashes, AboutTable grid)
nodes.rationale: Automatic wrapping splits sentences; term/description lists in a two-column Grid align descriptions; Test-Ui.ps1 enforces.
nodes.norm_label: on-screen prose rules (one sentence per line, no em dashes, abouttable grid)

nodes.label: $AppVersion as single version source
nodes.rationale: build.ps1 reads it by regex; must match git tag and last changelog entry because self-update compares them.

nodes.label: Signing certificate selection
nodes.rationale: Thumbprint env var, else cert matching committed .cer; never generate a replacement cert; build succeeds unsigned.

nodes.label: Publishing a release
nodes.rationale: Portable exe must be first .exe asset because copies up to 1.10.x pick the first executable.

nodes.label: Plan discipline (one commit per task, plan deleted when done)
nodes.rationale: Executed plans age and lie; durable content moves to changelog, ADR and README.
nodes.norm_label: plan discipline (one commit per task, plan deleted when done)

nodes.label: Publishing to winget-pkgs
nodes.rationale: wingetcreate submits last published manifest, not winget\<version>\, so copy back what was submitted.

nodes.label: Test suites (Test-Ui.ps1, Test-InvokeWinGet.ps1, CI)
nodes.rationale: Offline by default so CI can run them; -Live is a manual gate before release.

nodes.label: graphify knowledge graph
nodes.rationale: The why is spread across code comments, ADRs and changelog; the graph crosses those boundaries. Only report, graph.json, graph.html and manifest.json committed.

nodes.label: Defender Wacatac !ml false positive
nodes.rationale: ps2exe-compiled script with self-signed cert has no reputation; ML heuristic flags it. Fix: submit to Microsoft; exclusions fail under MDE/Intune.

nodes.label: Update locked until next Check
nodes.rationale: On-screen versions describe the machine before the queue; list not auto-rebuilt so Result column outcomes stay visible.

nodes.label: Search as you type (Install tab)
nodes.rationale: Grid is the suggestion list; MS Store only on explicit search because online is too slow for typing.

nodes.label: ADR 0017: App icon drawn in code
nodes.rationale: Single 256 px frame was blurred at 16-48 px where the icon is seen most; drawing in WPF needs no external tool and makes the icon a reviewable diff.
nodes.norm_label: adr 0017: app icon drawn in code

nodes.label: Cardboard box with >_ and download badge
nodes.rationale: Warm hexagon recognisable in a taskbar of blue squares; a blue box would look like Microsoft's own App Installer icon.
nodes.norm_label: cardboard box with >_ and download badge

nodes.label: src\icon.ps1 (WPF DrawingVisual -> RenderTargetBitmap)
nodes.rationale: Run by hand, output committed; needs STA thread; build does not run it.

nodes.label: 14 PNG frames in icon.ico
nodes.rationale: Microsoft's list of Win32 icon sizes; PNG frames accepted by ps2exe and Inno; fallback to 32-bit BMP for <=48 px if ever rejected.

nodes.label: Three levels of detail per size
nodes.rationale: A detail that cannot be drawn in whole pixels is dropped rather than left as a smudge.
nodes.norm_label: three levels of detail per size

nodes.label: Pixel-grid snapping (2:1 isometric slope)
nodes.rationale: Vertical edges on whole pixels, diagonals step two pixels, odd strokes on half pixels, keeping intermediate sizes sharp.

nodes.label: Rejected: SVG via Inkscape/ImageMagick or Edge headless
nodes.rationale: External tool on every rebuilding machine; Edge headless unreliable at 16-48 px with transparency.
nodes.norm_label: rejected: svg via inkscape/imagemagick or edge headless
